own_controls.interpretation: Group-validity correction does not change the centering subtraction. Exact-zero behavior is reported by row count/dtype, not assumed from valid-group count.
The middle member counts with its whole nonuniform group, even though that member has zero centered reward; num_valid is not count_nonzero(advantages).
Both versions count batch rows and rewards before final response-mask multiplication. This is an estimator boundary, not proof that a trainer supplies such rows.

scope: Complete original estimator bodies; registry decorators removed only. One original test function and parametrize retained, eight cases manually invoked per version (not native pytest); base 2 pass/6 assertion failures, head 8 pass. Three own boundary groups use real CPU tensors, no data/kernel mocks. Three full source inputs compile. No full module/registry, actor policy-loss/backward/optimizer, trainer batching/filtering, rejection/resampling, DP aggregation, GPU/NPU, model, training or performance executed.
execution_note: Eight original regressions matched expected base/head outcomes on first run. Initial eight-row fractional control yielded exact zero on this Torch build; expanded that same boundary group to 3/8/17 rows in FP32/FP64, reporting observed values rather than assuming a residual. Final run repeats all controls successfully. No production function change. Initial result update used an unsupported delete/add-same-path patch and was rejected without changing the file; corrected to a single update.
